using ll = long long;

const ll MOD = 1000000007;

ll power(ll base, ll exp, ll mod) {
    ll res = 1;
    while (exp) {
        if (exp & 1) res = (res * base) % mod;
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

ll p, k;
vector<bool> seen;

void traverse(int node) {
    if (!seen[node]) {
        seen[node] = true;
        traverse((k * node) % p);
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> p >> k;
    
    seen.assign(p, false);
    ll cycles = 0;
    
    for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
        if (!seen[i]) {
            traverse(i);
            ++cycles;
        }
    }
    
    ll ans = 1;
    if (k == 1) {
        ans = power(p, cycles + 1, MOD);
    } else {
        ans = power(p, cycles, MOD);
    }
    
    cout << ans << '\n';
    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using ll = long long;

inline void fast_io() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
}

constexpr ll MOD = 1000000007;

ll p_val, k_val;
vector<ll> component_id;
vector<bool> visited;

void dfs_visit(ll node) {
    if (node < p_val && !visited[node]) {
        visited[node] = true;
        component_id[node] = component_id.size() - 1;
        dfs_visit((k_val * node) % p_val);
    }
}

int main() {
    fast_io();
    
    cin >> p_val >> k_val;
    
    component_id.resize(p_val, -1);
    visited.assign(p_val, false);
    
    ll component_count = 0;
    
    for (ll i = 1; i < p_val; ++i) {
        if (!visited[i]) {
            dfs_visit(i);
            ++component_count;
        }
    }
    
    auto mod_pow = [](ll base, ll exp) -> ll {
        ll result = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    };
    
    ll answer = mod_pow(p_val, component_count);
    if (k_val == 1) {
        answer = (answer * p_val) % MOD;
    }
    
    cout << answer << '\n';
    return 0;
}
